title: MIDDAY STRENGTH
NEHEMIAH 6:9
poster: in the middle of your day
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun shining through a high office window
empty wooden desk with warm afternoon light streaming across
sunlit empty hallway with long afternoon shadows on the floor
wide open field under a bright cloudless midday sky
calm room with gentle sunbeams resting on an empty chair
quiet corner of a library with dust motes dancing in midday light
peaceful horizon under a high bright sun at noon

scenes.a: Right in the middle of your busy workday, take a breath and turn your heart to God.
You are carrying a heavy load right now, and the pressure feels very real.
Listen to the word of the Lord from Nehemiah chapter six, verse nine.
They were all trying to frighten us, thinking, their hands will get too weak for the work.
But now, O God, strengthen my hands.
Lord, when the demands of this hour press in on every side, renew our inward strength.
Grant us the quiet courage to keep going, trusting that Your grace is completely sufficient for today.
